title: Completing the Household Income on a Waiver Request — Benefit Overpayment Accounts
content:
A waiver request on one of the Benefit Overpayment Accounts that reached review without the household's annual income stands incomplete, and the claimant completes it on the record by confirming the income worked out for the request. The completion is made only on a request whose review is already open and does not itself open a review.

## What completion records

Completion writes the household's annual income onto the waiver request. The household size, the date the request was received and the request's status stay as they were. Once completed, the request under review carries the annual household income entered, and that income becomes the claimant's own statement of income on the application.

| Item on the waiver request | Before completion | After completion |
|---|---|---|
| Annual household income | 0.00, lodged without a figure | The income entered |
| Household size | As lodged | Unchanged |
| Date received | As lodged | Unchanged |
| Request status | As recorded | Unchanged |

## The completion tool

Completion is made with `complete_waiver_household_income_abba3816`, a tool that belongs to the claimant, by which the claimant fills in the annual household income on a waiver request the claimant lodged. The representative unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `overpayment_id` | The reference number of the benefit overpayment the waiver request was lodged for, as given to the claimant by the representative from the overpayment record | Reference number |
| `waiver_request_id` | The reference number of the claimant's waiver request, as given to the claimant by the representative from the waiver request record | Reference number |
| `annual_household_income` | The household's annual income, as the representative states it | USD, 2 decimal places; an amount with more decimals is rounded to the nearest cent when recorded |

**Return.** On success the receipt shows `waiver_request_id`, `overpayment_id`, `household_size` (the household size already on the request), `annual_household_income` (the income recorded, USD to 2 decimal places) and `request_status` (the request's unchanged status). A receipt showing the entered income means the request is completed. If the two reference numbers do not match one waiver request, the reply starts with "Error:" and nothing changes.

*Illustration (hypothetical values):* completing request WR-5120 on overpayment OP-5008 with 18400.00 returns `household_size` 1, `annual_household_income` 18400.0 and the request's status as it was.
